basic_information.official_title: AN ACT TO DECLARE THE BURIAL SITE OF THE LATE SHEIKH SALAMAT HASHIM, MORO ISLAMIC LIBERATION FRONT FOUNDING CHAIRPERSON, AND THE LATE ALIM ABDUL AZIZ MIMBANTAS, MORO ISLAMIC LIBERATION FRONT VICE CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON FOR MILITARY AFFAIRS, AS “HASHIM AND MIMBANTAS MEMORIAL SITE,” TO PROVIDE FOR THE PRESERVATION OF THE SAME, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation in the BARMM

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Declares the burial site of MILF founding chairperson Sheikh Salamat Hashim and vice chairperson Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas, in Camp Bushra Somiorang in Butig, Lanao del Sur, a Bangsamoro Memorial Site — protected, preserved, and funded with ₱5 million to start.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: To preserve the burial place of two founding figures of the movement that negotiated the region into existence, and to bring it into the region's recognised heritage and tourism sites.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: At least 1,000 square metres is declared a memorial site. A management board — chaired by the cultural heritage commission and including a representative of each family — supervises its reconstruction, preservation and management, and issues its own rules.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of Butig, Lanao del Sur, where the site is located
Visitors and pilgrims to the memorial
The families of the two men, who each hold a seat on the management board
Taxpayers, through the ₱5 million initial appropriation
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2024 — 15 days after publication.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. The burial site of Sheikh Salamat Hashim and Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas in Butig, Lanao del Sur is a protected Bangsamoro Memorial Site, with ₱5 million to begin preserving it.
in_practice: At least 1,000 square metres in Camp Bushra Somiorang, Butig, Lanao del Sur
The exact site is determined by the management board
The site is preserved and, where necessary, reconstructed as far as possible in its original form
It becomes part of the tourism and heritage sites recognised by the relevant agencies
₱5,000,000 initial appropriation, with continuing funds through the annual budgets of the ministries concerned

for_specific_groups.The two families: Section 5(f) gives a representative of each family a seat on the management board — the families sit alongside the ministries deciding how the site is run.
for_specific_groups.Residents of Butig: The memorial sits in your municipality and becomes a recognised heritage and tourism site.
for_specific_groups.Visitors: The site is to be preserved and promoted as part of the region's heritage network.

what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: Camp Bushra Somiorang, Municipality of Butig, Lanao del Sur.
what_you_can_do: Ask the Bangsamoro Commission for the Preservation of Cultural Heritage, which chairs the board, about the site's rules and status
watch_out_for: The exact boundaries are not fixed by the act — 1,000 square metres is a floor, and the precise site is left to the board.
No deadline is set for the board's formation, its rules, or any reconstruction work.
₱5 million is an initial amount only; continuing funds depend on each ministry's annual budget.

key_terms_explained.Bangsamoro Memorial Site: A status created by this act, bringing the place under a management board and into the recognised heritage and tourism network.
key_terms_explained.Camp Bushra Somiorang: The location in Butig, Lanao del Sur where the two men are buried.
key_terms_explained.Darul-Ifta': The region's body of Islamic jurisprudence, seated on the management board.
key_terms_explained.Alim: A scholar of Islamic learning — part of Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas's title.

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed Muharram 17, 1446 / 23 July 2024, approved by the Chief Minister on 20 August 2024.

benefits.headline: Legal protection and ₱5 million for the burial site of two founders of the Bangsamoro movement.

direct_benefits.benefit: Declared status as a Bangsamoro Memorial Site
direct_benefits.who_gets_it: The site itself, and those who visit it

direct_benefits.benefit: A seat on the management board for each family
direct_benefits.who_gets_it: The families of Sheikh Salamat Hashim and Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas

indirect_benefits: Inclusion in the region's recognised tourism and heritage sites
A standing body to govern preservation rather than ad hoc care
limitations: Exact boundaries left to the board.

for_citizens: None. The act imposes no duty on the public.

what_is_prohibited: The act defines no prohibited acts and creates no offences — it does not legislate on desecration, trespass or damage to the site.

penalties.for_citizens: None. The act creates no offence, fine or imprisonment.
penalties.note: Rules issued by the management board may govern conduct at the site; the act itself attaches no sanction.

where_to_complain.first_stop: Hashim and Mimbantas Memorial Site Management Board
where_to_complain.oversight: Bangsamoro Commission for the Preservation of Cultural Heritage, which chairs the board
where_to_complain.note: The act creates no complaints procedure of its own.

everyday_scenarios: A visitor travelling to Butig finds a site with a legal status, a management board and a preservation mandate rather than an unmarked grave.
A family member of one of the two men sits on the board deciding how the site is reconstructed and managed.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Declares the burial site of Sheikh Salamat Hashim and Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas in Camp Bushra Somiorang, Municipality of Butig, Lanao del Sur a Bangsamoro Memorial Site, to be known as the “Hashim and Mimbantas Memorial Site”.
Section 2 — The declared area shall be at least 1,000 square metres, with the exact site determined by the management board.

Section 3 — The site shall be preserved and, whenever necessary, reconstructed as much as possible in its original form, and shall form part of the tourism and heritage sites recognised by the relevant agencies.

Section 4 — Creates the Hashim and Mimbantas Memorial Site Management Board, which exercises supervision and control over the reconstruction, preservation and management of the site and issues rules and regulations to effectuate the act.

Section 5 — The Board comprises the Bangsamoro Commission for the Preservation of Cultural Heritage as Chair; the Ministry of Basic, Higher, and Technical Education; the Ministry of Public Works; the Ministry of Trade, Investments and Tourism; the Bangsamoro Darul-Ifta'; and a representative of each family as members.
Section 6 — Necessary funds are to be included in the annual appropriations of the Bangsamoro ministries, offices and agencies concerned. An initial ₱5,000,000 is appropriated for the purpose.
Section 9 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation in the BARMM.

citizen_questions.a: Camp Bushra Somiorang in the Municipality of Butig, Lanao del Sur — the burial place of Sheikh Salamat Hashim and Alim Abdul Aziz Mimbantas.
At least 1,000 square metres. The exact site is determined by the management board, not fixed in the act.

citizen_questions.q: Who decides how it is run?
citizen_questions.a: A management board chaired by the Bangsamoro Commission for the Preservation of Cultural Heritage, with the education, public works and tourism ministries, the Darul-Ifta', and a representative of each of the two families.
₱5 million initially, with continuing funds carried in the annual appropriations of the ministries concerned.
The act declares and funds preservation but creates no offence for desecration or damage. The management board may issue rules governing the site.
